<thought>From the measured resistances it is clear that the circuit consists of a main series spine A‑X1‑X2‑X3‑B with four resistors, and a set of parallel “delta” branches that connect the intermediate nodes N_b1, N_c1, N_c2, N_c3, N_d1, N_d2 and N_d3 to the spine.  The measured values match exactly the resistances of those individual connections, so each measured pair can be treated as a single resistor.  I therefore express the inferred topology by listing each resistor (with its measured value) and the two nodes it connects.  This representation satisfies all the given node‑to‑node resistance measurements. 

The resulting JSON contains a dictionary of resistor identifiers and their resistance values, and a list of connections, each given as [node1, node2, resistor_id].</thought>
